name: AnmManager__LoadAnm
comment: [NC first-hand] LoadAnm(this, anmIdx, path, spriteIdxOffset). Signature matches the TH06 community reconstruction parameter for parameter.

name: AnmManager__SetActiveSprite
comment: [NC first-hand] Resolves a script-relative sprite index against the manager's per-anm sprite base table and stores it into vm+0x100.

name: AnmManager__Draw
comment: [NC first-hand] Main draw path. Reads the anchor field (vm+0xc4 & 0x700) and compares it by value, not by bit -- see the anchor enum.

name: AnmManager__SeekInterruptLabel
comment: [NC first-hand] Scans the script for an opcode-22 label matching vm+0x8a, remembering the -1 (default) label. Opcode 22 is a no-op during execution.

name: AnmManager__ExecuteScript
comment: [NC first-hand] ANM v0 script interpreter. Instruction header is {s16 time; u8 opcode; u8 args_size} with args at +4; dispatch is a 36-entry jump table at 0x140007494 bounded by CMP DL,0x23.

name: Input__PublishButtonBitmap
comment: [NC first-hand] Merges keyboard bits with XInput pad state and writes the 6-bit pad bitmap g_PadCheatButtons (0x140c21e58).

name: Input__CollectKeyboard
comment: [NC first-hand] Rebuilds the layout-aware scancode remap table at 0x140c21e60 via GetKeyboardLayout/MapVirtualKeyExW, then feeds the logical button bitmap builder. This is why the cheat is typed as letters, not key positions.

name: EclManager__RunEcl
comment: [TH06 baseline + NC verified] Per-enemy ECL interpreter. The record layout, difficulty mask, variable encoding, time gate, and offset-to-next loop match TH06.

name: EnemyManager__SpawnEnemy
comment: [TH06 baseline + NC verified] Allocates an enemy slot, initializes its ECL context, selects a subroutine from g_EclSubTable, and runs its first ECL frame.

name: EnemyManager__RunEclTimeline
comment: [TH06 baseline + NC verified] Stage timeline interpreter. Runtime dispatch remains limited to opcodes 0..12 and advances by the int16 size field at +0x06.

name: ResultScreen__UpdateUnlockCheats
comment: [NC first-hand] Runs the keyboard cheat, then an inlined 4-step XInput pad cheat over the 0x140c21e58 bitmap (hold L3+R3, Y, X, hold LB+RB). Either success sets the score.dat dirty flag at +0x9e99.

name: ResultScreen__UpdateKeyboardUnlockCheat
comment: [NC first-hand] Types-the-password cheat. Edge-detects the 8 letters of the 0x14030c520 table, walks "classiclager" via +0x4430, and on the 12th letter fills the CLRD table with 99. Wrong letter resets to 0, 'c' restarts at 1.

name: ResultScreen__OnUpdate
comment: [NC first-hand] Result-screen per-frame tick. Switches on +0x9e94 through the 18-entry jump table at 0x140072824; only state 6 (Lunatic records) reaches the cheat call at 0x14006fab4.

name: ResultScreen__WriteScoreDat
comment: [NC first-hand] Serializes HSCR/CLRD/CATK/PSCR and writes score.dat. The whole body is gated on the +0x9e99 dirty flag, which the unlock cheats set.
